text:
minji: Heads-up — during q8 bring-up of nova-v1 on canary we see ZERO-WIDTH JOINER (ZWJ) being dropped in vertical/furigana outputs. Small repro below.

raj: can you paste a minimal repro? which model tag + quant config?

minji: model: nova-v1@2026-03-10, quant: q8_kernel_opt, region: asia-east-canary. repro prompt and outputs: 
```
PROMPT:
「漢字‍仮名」  # expect joiner between Han+Kana for ruby placement

MODEL OUTPUT (float32):
「漢字‍仮名"

MODEL OUTPUT (q8):
「漢字仮名」
```

minji: quick eval on our furigana testset: float32 BLEU=34.1, q8 BLEU=30.8 (delta -3.3). Per-sentence diffs show ZWJ missing in ~12% of samples under q8. Tokenizer mapping shows ZWJ id preserved pre-run but detok after q8 seems to drop it.

sophia: curious — are we running the same detokenizer flags? preserve_zwj was recently added as a flag, maybe default changed in runtime config.

kevin: can you dump token ids + the runtime packing logs? my hunch: a packing/normalization fast-path strips zero-width chars when compressing sequences for kvcache.

minji: token ids for that sample: [3452, 1, 6723]  (3452=HAN, 1=ZWJ, 6723=KANA). q8 run log excerpt: 
```
runtime.conf: strip_zero_width=true
pack_kv: enabled
kernel: fast_pack_v2
```
In float32 run strip_zero_width=false.

raj: if strip_zero_width flag flips between f32/q8 codepath that's an immediate bug. Also want to confirm whether the detok step later is intentionally removing ZWJ or it's being lost earlier.

triage-bot: Created INF-5577: "q8: ZWJ dropped in vertical/furigana detok" — assigned to kevin.

kevin: I'll bisect the runtime change that introduced strip_zero_width. Suspect commit c1b2a3 that added aggressive whitespace normalizer for packing.

minji: FYI I ran a quick q4a canary on staging — same behavior but less frequent (q4a dropping in ~5% samples).

kevin: next steps: reproduce locally with q8 emu (cpu), capture token-level traces across tokenizer -> model -> kvcache pack -> detok. If ZWJ present in token stream pre-pack and missing post-unpack, we know it's packing.

raj: also run full furigana testset and produce per-locale regression report. add a short eval script: `python eval/run_furigana_diff.py --model nova-v1 --quant q8 --out /tmp/q8_furi.csv`

minji: added initial results to the ticket (samples, BLEU, token diffs) and linked the canary recordings. I'll also open PR to temporarily turn off normalize_spaces for CJK locales to stop user-facing regressions while we root cause. :thumbsup:

sophia: add kernel engineers to INF-5577 thread; we may need a perf tradeoff if we disable the fast-path.

kevin: noted. I'll follow up with a bisect and post a short summary here when I have the offending commit.

minji: thanks all — pinging here once the bisect/PR lands. INF-5577 link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5577 :eyes:
